decisions.statement: The game's own map ping functions are wrapped rather than replaced.
Every ping change is announced to callers on both sides of the change.
A muted ping is drawn without a sound.
A suppressed ping is drawn as no pin.
A ping the game never announces is announced by a watchdog instead.
A group ping is sent only while the token bucket has a token.
This library needs LibDebugLogger loaded first.

definition: the game's map ping functions wrapped in one place every addon reaches
